_doc: Corsair line (spec #384, ticket C2 #386). A class spec adds jobs/corsair.json, skills/corsair.json and asset_manifest.d/corsair.json, discovered automatically by DataRepo.lines() (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Job 522 stays playable: false until C14 flips it; the thirteen pool keys are inert until the skill tickets (C3-C13) define them in skills/corsair.json (or, for Dash, skills/pirate.json), and until then they are never offered or learned. The AP row lives in this file's balance block. default_job stays 212.

522._starting_skill: tier C: spec #384 (CS-1): Double Shot (the old Gunslinger skill, 5201001) is the starting active in slot 1 and the first skill a round learns; defined by C4 in skills/corsair.json.
522._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #384 (CS-2): Dash (WZ 5001005) is Corsair's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; defined once in skills/pirate.json on slot mobility (Buccaneer B5 #417), C3 gives it the shared mobility rank rule.
522._skill_pool: tier C: spec #384 (CS-1 to CS-12): the thirteen hand-picked Corsair actives from the 500/520/521/522 books, all auto-cast; Dash is the mobility skill, not a pool entry. Undefined keys stay inert until their tickets define them.
522._weapon_families: tier C: spec #384: guns only (WeaponInfo family gun, 149xxxx); knucklers (148xxxx) belong to Buccaneer. Bows, crossbows, claws, swords and every other family never drop for a Corsair. Armour drops by the Pirate class bit.
522._creation_weapon: tier A: the Pistol (Item.wz 1492000, reqJob 16 = the Pirate bit; its level requirement is gone with #292). Already in the Pirate manifest fragment and the shipped drop list.
522._provenance: tier C: spec #384 C2 #386: Corsair is data-only until C14 flips playable; 212 remains the default.

hub_kit._fixture: tier C: spec #384 C14 #398: the Corsair fixture (tier 2, the tier-1 gun kit); tool-only.
hub_kit._kit: tier C: spec #384 C14 #398: the five gun ATT scrolls of scrolls/pirate.json (100/60/10, dark 70% and 30%; v83 has no gun ACC scrolls), 10 per stack; spare gear is a second pistol (1492001, Lv15) and the all-job hat, gloves and top (the cache holds no armour with the Pirate bit; Buccaneer's kit does the same); the flow driver's diagnostic item is the Lv40 gun 1492006.

522._ap: tier C: spec #384 (CS-12): the shared 520 row copied verbatim (DEX primary, STR secondary, keyframes Lv1 -> 1 and Lv200 -> 200: the Gunslinger gear pattern, no new tuning), explicit so 522 does not depend on lineage rows the Buccaneer spec may touch. No hp key: the starting HP is the shared default and HP growth inherits the 500 row (25).

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #384 (C14 #398): every pool skill is scored explicitly, learn 100 and rank 74, the numbers BotInput's pool default gives every curated skill. Octopus, Gaviota and the Battleship need their pair: BotInput._base_score alone only treats projectile / instant / box skills as attacks and these are summons and a form; the other ten entries are a guard, not a behaviour change. Battleship's Cannon and Torpedo are form subs with no cards.
